entities.summary: Irvin Martin Smith Jr. is an American professional football tight end. He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide and was selected in the second round of the 2019 NFL draft by the Minnesota Vikings. He also played for the Cincinnati Bengals and the Kansas City Chiefs.
